risk: Very small dataset with only 12 records
mitigation: Obtain a larger representative dataset before making deployment decisions

risk: Unverified dataset provenance and usage permission
mitigation: Confirm source licensing and permitted use with the dataset provider

risk: Unverified churn target definition and prediction horizon
mitigation: Confirm label definition and future observation window

risk: Potential data leakage from features unavailable at prediction time
mitigation: Audit feature timing and exclude post-outcome information
Measure precision and assess the cost of unnecessary retention outreach
Measure recall and review missed churn cases

risk: Potential bias from unrepresentative customer records
mitigation: Verify sampling method and evaluate appropriate groups when data permits

risk: Customer privacy or unauthorised data disclosure
mitigation: Verify permissions and remove or protect unnecessary identifying information

risk: Unreliable evaluation due to small test sample
mitigation: Report uncertainty and obtain more independent evaluation data
